_about: Script and timeline of the trailer (issue #99), draft v2.2. Durations are in beats at 96 bpm (0.625 s per beat). A shot's picture is either a new scene drawn by scenes.py ('scene') or the paper figure or notebook animation it will be remade from ('still_from'); every plot is remade for the video by these scripts, and no figure source is edited. Every word card and code line is for the author to approve.

shots.visual: new schematic: one neutrino rides two parallel tracks, vacuum above and matter of varying density below (the track glows with the density); on each track P(nu_mu -> nu_e) draws itself up to where the neutrino is, and the two curves part
shots.source: new: tools/trailer/data.py (Magnus, 3 GeV, 0 to 10,000 km) and scenes.py; the video animates the neutrino's position

shots.visual: new diagram: a 5 x 5 grid, experiments down, theories across; solver files fill it cell by cell on the beat, then every row's arrow converges on one box, H(E, x)
the pile of solver files blurs; the three phrases hit on the beat
the pile collapses into the logotype; the four lines land one per two beats (author's wording)

words: You only need to give a Hamiltonian.
shots.visual: new diagram: H(E, x) = H_vac/E + V(x) P_e + H_new(x) writes itself; each term lights its card: vacuum (the flavor content of the three mass states, from NuFIT), matter (a constant and a varying V(x)), beyond the Standard Model (four chips)
the code types in; beside it the matter curve of the opening redraws from this call
shots.source: checked by tools/trailer/data.py (step code): runs without a warning and matches osc_prob_matter_std_potential to 4e-8 (H_vac, V, P_e built off screen)

shots.visual: new diagram: from 'your call', five branches light in turn: constant density, energy scan, baseline scan, one point at modest phase, one point at extreme phase, each to its engine
shots.source: new: tools/trailer/scenes.py, diagram 4 (from the strategy docs of osc_prob_matter_std_potential)

words: Sharp change: found, and solved exactly.
shots.visual: new schematic: a 10 MeV neutrino leaves a dense stellar envelope and crosses the MSW resonance three times. The instantaneous levels draw along its path; the two slow crossings glow teal (adiabatic transport); at the shock front Magnus flags a 600 km window, the view zooms into it, and it turns amber (exact Magnus patch). Below, P(nu_e -> nu_e) lands one dot per call; the engine name under each dot flips from 'magnus' (short paths) to 'hybrid' (long ones).
shots.source: new: tools/trailer/data.py. strategy='auto' per point: 15 calls answered by the Magnus ladder, 225 by the hybrid, no warnings; the hybrid finds one window at the shock; every checked point within 3.2e-5 of an independent reference (common.reference_pee, no Magnus code). 4.7 million km path, shock width 105 km, illustrative profile.

shots.visual: new diagram: bars for the flavor content of each mass state, growing from 2 to 3, 3+1 and 3+2 flavors
shots.source: new: tools/trailer/scenes.py, diagram 6 (the package's mixing matrices)

bi-probability ellipses trace as delta_CP runs
the 3+1 curve peels away from the standard one
the NSI curve peels away
the LIV curve peels away
the front sweeps; t_breakpoints=front flashes on screen

words: See the Sun through its neutrinos
shots.visual: the solar discs: the Sun face-on in the nu_e channel builds ray by ray, then a slow zoom
the beam sweeps across a buried body; the change-in-probability map builds angle by angle
Borexino geometry; the flux map lights up by source region
a jet head moves out through three envelopes; the survival probability follows
a long-range-force coupling dial turns; the solar curve bends

shots.sub: Adaptive until successive answers agree, and it warns when they don't.
shots.visual: new diagram: the path is cut into slabs, one exponential each, multiplied into U; beside it the real ladder at one point (2 to 21 slabs) jumps, then two answers agree within 1e-5
shots.source: new: tools/trailer/scenes.py, diagram 3 (fixed-slab Magnus runs at 3 GeV, 10,000 km)

shots.sub: Thousands of energies in one call.
shots.visual: new diagram: 2000 energies stream into one osc_prob_3nu_earth call; the spectrum lands in one piece
shots.source: new: tools/trailer/scenes.py, diagram 5 (a real 2000-energy Earth call; no timing shown)

shots.sub: Any Hamiltonian, any number of flavors.
shots.visual: the Hamiltonian chips from act 4 return and lock into place
the install line types in; docs and code links fade in; the author line; the logotype with its three words last

decisions: The script: these words, or your own (the burden lines, the reveal card with your four lines, the adiabatic-scene lines, and the three pillar lines).
The opening: 3 GeV over 0–10,000 km through an illustrative density profile (3 to 10 g/cm³ with a ripple), or a real one such as a PREM chord.
“Fast.”: the words only, as now, or with a timing measured for the video on a stated machine.

The adiabatic scene: this illustrative stellar envelope with one shock, or a published supernova profile (the scene needs a shock sharp enough to be non-adiabatic; a sharper shock on a longer path is a case the hybrid currently gets wrong without a warning, issue #100).
The music: with the melody that plays a computed probability, or pad and pulse only.
Length: {length} plus a 45 s social cut, or {length} only.
Hosting: a GitHub release asset with a README embed, YouTube, or both.
The ending card: it carries the docs site and your name and email; add affiliation, funding acknowledgments, the paper reference?
